description: Generate deterministic seed records from field specs and a numeric seed: the same seed and specs always produce the same records.

fields.description: Field specs, in output order (at least one)

from.description: Earliest date for date fields, YYYY-MM-DD (optional, default "2020-01-01")

max.description: Upper bound for integer/number fields (optional; integer default 100, number default 1)

min.description: Lower bound for integer/number fields (optional; integer default 0, number default 0)

name.description: Field name (unique across the field specs)

to.description: Latest date for date fields, YYYY-MM-DD (optional, default "2020-12-31")

values.description: Choices for enum fields (required for enum, at least one non-empty string)

seed.description: Seed for the pinned PRNG (unsigned 32-bit integer)

name: generate_seed_data
